features.title: App shell: pinned Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind, lint and format
features.acceptance: package.json pins Next 16.4.3/React 19.3.0/Tailwind 4.3.3; tsconfig strict; eslint flat config; prettier with 4-space project habit; dev script uses port 3001.

features.title: Self-hosted Geist Sans + Geist Mono
features.acceptance: Fonts load from the geist npm package, never fonts.googleapis.com; dev HTML and network evidence show no Google Fonts request.

features.title: Root layout, metadata and brand tokens
features.acceptance: layout.tsx carries Daniel's title template, description and Open Graph base with no invented domain/email; globals.css defines #F5F3EE/#1B211F/#508478 tokens and focus-visible + reduced-motion rules.

features.title: Home page
features.acceptance: Eyebrow, heading, intro, supporting line, primary CTA to /projects, secondary to /about, and a restrained project teaser; no borrowed koi/art motifs.

features.title: Desktop and mobile navigation
features.acceptance: Home/Projects/About only; keyboard reachable in order, visible focus, aria-current, mobile menu aria-expanded/controls and Escape close; prefers-reduced-motion respected.

features.title: Projects index at /projects
features.acceptance: All seven projects from typed data; visible status label on desktop and mobile; no unlaunched demo buttons or missing links.

features.title: Project detail at /projects/[slug]
features.acceptance: Context, role, approach, artifacts, outcome and current status rendered from data; story paragraphs shown once; placeholder media explicitly labelled; no invented metrics, screenshots or links; 404 for unknown slug.

features.title: About page
features.acceptance: Three-paragraph brand-doc draft, capabilities from the brand doc, only verified links; no fabricated contact details.

features.title: Quiet editorial polish
features.acceptance: Inline link treatment, consistent hairline/status system, cheap page-enter transition disabled under reduced motion, responsive 360/1440 layouts.

features.title: Quality gates and browser smoke test
features.acceptance: npm ci, npm run lint, npx tsc --noEmit and npm run build exit 0 on the final tree; every route checked at 1440 and 360 with keyboard order and reduced motion; evidence recorded in NOW.md.
